parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: White cylindrical plastic shell forming the main lower body of the lipstick container.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal slider mechanism and provides the primary structural grip for the user.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface with a parallel jaw gripper to stabilize the object during manipulation.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic casing enclosing an empty cavity for the mechanism.

parts.description: White cylindrical plastic shell forming the main lower body of the lipstick container.
parts.function: Houses the internal slider mechanism and provides the primary structural grip for the user.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: Thin green ring encircling the top rim of the tube base where the cap meets the body.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a decorative accent or sealing interface between the cap and the base.
physics.Grasped_description: Too narrow and flush to be grasped independently; avoid targeting this specific band.
physics.reason: Likely a solid thin ring or integral molded feature with negligible internal volume relative to its size.

parts.description: Thin green ring encircling the top rim of the tube base where the cap meets the body.
parts.function: Acts as a decorative accent or sealing interface between the cap and the base.

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: Small blue rectangular tab protruding from the side slot of the white tube.
physics.Functional_description: Serves as the actuator knob to slide the lipstick bullet up and down within the track.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile for primary grasping; would be pressed or slid by a fingertip or narrow tool.
physics.reason: Small functional component molded as a solid piece to withstand sliding forces.

parts.description: Small blue rectangular tab protruding from the side slot of the white tube.
parts.function: Serves as the actuator knob to slide the lipstick bullet up and down within the track.

parts.name: bullet red

physics.Basic_description: Red waxy cosmetic stick with a rounded tip, visible at the opening of the tube.
physics.Functional_description: The actual lipstick product intended for application to the lips.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp directly as the material is soft, deformable, and easily damaged by gripper pressure.
physics.reason: Dense wax/paste material filling the entire volume of the bullet shape.

parts.description: Red waxy cosmetic stick with a rounded tip, visible at the opening of the tube.
parts.function: The actual lipstick product intended for application to the lips.

parts.name: cap shell

physics.Basic_description: White cylindrical plastic cover shown detached, matching the diameter of the tube body.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the lipstick bullet from damage and drying out when the container is closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface to lift the cap off or place it back onto the tube base.
physics.reason: Hollow shell structure designed to fit over the tube base, containing only air.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
